claims.text: Recommended tx of trichinellosis: either mebendazole or albendazole.
claims.quote: The recommended treatment of trichinellosis is either mebendazole or albendazole.

claims.text: If tx isn't started within the first several days of infection, more prolonged or repeated courses may be needed.
claims.quote: If treatment is not initiated within the first several days of infection, more prolonged or repeated courses of treatment may be necessary.

claims.text: Both considered relatively safe but associated w ADRs including bone marrow suppression.
claims.quote: Both drugs are considered relatively safe but have been associated with side effects including bone marrow suppression.

claims.text: Not approved for pregnant women or children < 2 years.
claims.quote: Albendazole and mebendazole are not approved for use in pregnant women or children under the age of 2 years.
